EmailTemplate.description: Sent to a Contact or Lead when an identity verification is requested. Includes the verification link and plain-text fallback URL.
EmailTemplate.name: Incode Verification Request
EmailTemplate.subject: Action required: Please complete your identity verification
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hi {!Contact.FirstName},
We need to verify your identity as part of our onboarding process.
Please visit the following link to complete your verification: {!Incode_Verification__c.Verification_URL__c}
This link is unique to you — please do not share it with others.
